verses.html: 1 Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.
verses.text: 1 Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.

verses.html: 2 And He taught them many things in parables, and in His teaching He said,
verses.text: 2 And He taught them many things in parables, and in His teaching He said,

verses.html: 3 “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
verses.text: 3 “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.

verses.html: 4 And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
verses.text: 4 And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.

verses.html: 5 Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
verses.text: 5 Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.

verses.html: 6 But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
verses.text: 6 But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

verses.html: 7 Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings, and they yielded no crop.
verses.text: 7 Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings, and they yielded no crop.

verses.html: 8 Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”
verses.text: 8 Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”

verses.html: 9 Then Jesus said, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.text: 9 Then Jesus said, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

verses.html: 10 As soon as Jesus was alone with the Twelve and those around Him, they asked Him about the parable.
verses.text: 10 As soon as Jesus was alone with the Twelve and those around Him, they asked Him about the parable.

verses.html: 11 He replied, “The mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to those on the outside everything is expressed in parables,
verses.text: 11 He replied, “The mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to those on the outside everything is expressed in parables,

verses.html: 12 so that, ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven.’”
verses.text: 12 so that, ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven.’”

verses.html: 13 Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?
verses.text: 13 Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?

verses.html: 14 The farmer sows the word.
verses.text: 14 The farmer sows the word.

verses.html: 15 Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
verses.text: 15 Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.

verses.html: 16 Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
verses.text: 16 Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.

verses.html: 17 But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
verses.text: 17 But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.

verses.html: 18 Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,
verses.text: 18 Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,

verses.html: 19 but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
verses.text: 19 but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

verses.html: 20 Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”

verses.html: 1 Sometime later, Jesus again started to instruct people while he was next to the Sea of Galilee. A very large group of people assembled to hear him. Because {there were so many people}, he got into a boat on the sea and sat down {to teach}. All the people stood on the shore, by the water.
verses.text: 1 Sometime later, Jesus again started to instruct people while he was next to the Sea of Galilee. A very large group of people assembled to hear him. Because {there were so many people}, he got into a boat on the sea and sat down {to teach}. All the people stood on the shore, by the water.

verses.html: 2 Jesus began to use stories to instruct them about many things. As he was instructing them, he said,
verses.text: 2 Jesus began to use stories to instruct them about many things. As he was instructing them, he said,

verses.html: 3 “Listen to this: a farmer began to plant some grain seeds
verses.text: 3 “Listen to this: a farmer began to plant some grain seeds

verses.html: 4 As he was scattering them over the soil, some of the seeds fell on the path. Then some birds flew down and ate those seeds up.
verses.text: 4 As he was scattering them over the soil, some of the seeds fell on the path. Then some birds flew down and ate those seeds up.

verses.html: 5 Other seeds fell on shallow soil on top of a layer of rocks. Because they were growing in shallow soil, the seeds sprouted very quickly.
verses.text: 5 Other seeds fell on shallow soil on top of a layer of rocks. Because they were growing in shallow soil, the seeds sprouted very quickly.

verses.html: 6 Then, the sun shone on the new plants and dried them up. Then, because they did not have good roots, the plants died.
verses.text: 6 Then, the sun shone on the new plants and dried them up. Then, because they did not have good roots, the plants died.

verses.html: 7 Other seeds fell onto an area full of thorny plants. These thorny plants grew quickly and crowded out the grain plants. So, the grain plants did not produce a crop.
verses.text: 7 Other seeds fell onto an area full of thorny plants. These thorny plants grew quickly and crowded out the grain plants. So, the grain plants did not produce a crop.

verses.html: 8 Finally, other seeds fell on fertile soil. They grew quickly, and they produced a crop. Some plants produced 30 {grains of wheat each}, others produced 60 {grains each}, and others produced 100 {grains each}.”
verses.text: 8 Finally, other seeds fell on fertile soil. They grew quickly, and they produced a crop. Some plants produced 30 {grains of wheat each}, others produced 60 {grains each}, and others produced 100 {grains each}.”

verses.html: 9 Then Jesus told them, “You should think carefully about what you just heard me say!”
verses.text: 9 Then Jesus told them, “You should think carefully about what you just heard me say!”

verses.html: 10 Later, when no one else was with them, Jesus’ 12 representatives and some other apprentices asked Jesus to explain the stories he had told.
verses.text: 10 Later, when no one else was with them, Jesus’ 12 representatives and some other apprentices asked Jesus to explain the stories he had told.

verses.html: 11 He replied, “God has revealed to you hidden things about his kingdom. However, I use only stories to instruct people who are not my apprentices.
verses.text: 11 He replied, “God has revealed to you hidden things about his kingdom. However, I use only stories to instruct people who are not my apprentices.

verses.html: 12 That way, {just as you can read in the Scriptures,} ‘They will look at things, but they will not really see them. They will hear things, but they will not learn from them. Otherwise, they would stop doing what is wrong, and God would forgive them.’”
verses.text: 12 That way, {just as you can read in the Scriptures,} ‘They will look at things, but they will not really see them. They will hear things, but they will not learn from them. Otherwise, they would stop doing what is wrong, and God would forgive them.’”

verses.html: 13 Then Jesus told his apprentices, “Unless you realize what that story means, you will not be able to realize what any of the other stories {that I tell} mean.
verses.text: 13 Then Jesus told his apprentices, “Unless you realize what that story means, you will not be able to realize what any of the other stories {that I tell} mean.

verses.html: 14 {In the story that I told you,} the seeds that the farmer planted represent the good news.
verses.text: 14 {In the story that I told you,} the seeds that the farmer planted represent the good news.

verses.html: 15 Some people are like the seeds that fell on the path. They hear the good news. However, as soon as they hear it, Satan comes and makes them forget the message that they heard.
verses.text: 15 Some people are like the seeds that fell on the path. They hear the good news. However, as soon as they hear it, Satan comes and makes them forget the message that they heard.

verses.html: 16 Other people are like the seeds that fell on shallow soil on top of a layer of rocks. When they hear the good news, they rejoice and quickly believe it.
verses.text: 16 Other people are like the seeds that fell on shallow soil on top of a layer of rocks. When they hear the good news, they rejoice and quickly believe it.

verses.html: 17 However, they are like plants without good roots, which do not live very long. In fact, when bad things happen or when people hurt them because they accepted the good news, they quickly stop believing it.
verses.text: 17 However, they are like plants without good roots, which do not live very long. In fact, when bad things happen or when people hurt them because they accepted the good news, they quickly stop believing it.

verses.html: 18 Other people are like the seeds that fell onto an area full of thorny plants. They hear the good news.
verses.text: 18 Other people are like the seeds that fell onto an area full of thorny plants. They hear the good news.

verses.html: 19 However, they continue to focus on things in this world. They try to become rich, even though being rich is not as helpful as they think it will be. Also, they desire many other things. When they do those things, it makes the good news ineffective, just as thorny plants crowd out the good plants and keep them from producing a crop.
verses.text: 19 However, they continue to focus on things in this world. They try to become rich, even though being rich is not as helpful as they think it will be. Also, they desire many other things. When they do those things, it makes the good news ineffective, just as thorny plants crowd out the good plants and keep them from producing a crop.

verses.html: 20 Finally, other people are like the seeds that fell on fertile soil. When they hear the good news, they believe it. They are like the plants that produced a crop. Some plants produced 30 {grains of wheat each}, others produced 60 {grains each}, and others produced 100 {grains each}.”

Some plants produced 30 {grains of wheat each}, others produced 60 {grains each}, and others produced 100 {grains each}.”
